title: UMPIRE CALL TIME
style: Industrial rock with heavy electronic influences. Distorted electric guitar riffs play syncopated power chords. A gritty synth bass follows the guitar line. Drums feature a compressed, punchy snare and a driving kick pattern with frequent double-kick accents. Aggressive male vocals utilize a mix of melodic singing and raspy shouting. High-pitched synth leads provide melodic counterpoints during the chorus. The track features sudden dynamic shifts and glitchy electronic transitions. Key: E minor. Tempo: 145 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drums]
[humming]

[Verse 1]
[aggressive male vocals]
From the moment you're up
It's on your mind
Never fully unwind
Lining up the games
Each is not the same
We are all hooked
The courts are booked

[Chorus]
[full band, heavy synth bass]
Empire!
[drum fill]
Empire!

[Verse 2]
Rumbling at the gates
Valiant can't wait
On-court time
Get on the line
Head is throbbing
Teammates bobbing
Getting down and dirty
It's only 10:30

[Chorus]
Empire!
[synth lead enters]
Now fully unwind

[Bridge]
[guitar solo, rapid double-kick drums]
Dignity online
Dignity online
Dignity online
Dignity, dignity online

[Outro]
[drums drop out, synth pad]
Feel the rush
Feel the pain
Can't wait till I play again
[glitch effect]
Again
